{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research and Development Expense Variability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of research and development expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with more variable R&D expenses may be taking on more risk and thus may be more likely to experience large outcomes, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the difference between the current year's inventory turnover and the average inventory turnover over the past 3 years.", "rationale": "An increase in inventory turnover may indicate improving operational efficiency, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the change in capital expenditures over the past year, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with increasing capital expenditures may be investing in growth opportunities, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Persistence", "construction": "Calculate the autoregressive coefficient of advertising expenses over the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms with persistent advertising expenses may be building strong brands, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of the change in total employees over the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile employee growth may be experiencing changes in their business model, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Receivable Days Outstanding", "construction": "Calculate the average days outstanding for accounts receivable over the past year.", "rationale": "Firms with shorter days outstanding for accounts receivable may have stronger customer relationships, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Taxes Paid Persistence", "construction": "Calculate the autoregressive coefficient of taxes paid over the past 5 years.", "rationale": "Firms with persistent taxes paid may be experiencing stable profitability, which could lead to lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Intangible Assets Growth", "construction": "Calculate the change in intangible assets over the past year, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with growing intangible assets may be developing valuable intellectual property, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Operating Lease Expense Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of operating lease expenses to total expenses.", "rationale": "Firms with lower operating lease expenses may have more flexible cost structures, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Deferred Tax Assets to Liabilities Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of deferred tax assets to deferred tax liabilities.", "rationale": "Firms with a higher ratio of deferred tax assets to liabilities may be experiencing temporary tax benefits, which could lead to higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
